meta.title: Dublin Crime Explorer
meta.sourceLabel: Central Statistics Office — recorded crime incidents
meta.geographyNote: Markers show authoritative station locations, not catchment boundaries. A station name must not be read as the boundary of the suburb with the same name.
meta.dataNote: Recorded incidents are not actual prevalence. Reporting behaviour, Garda activity, footfall and land use affect comparisons.
meta.fraudNote: CJA11 station-level fraud data is not comparable for 2023 and is unavailable from 2024; recent all-category totals therefore exclude fraud.
meta.vehicleNote: CJA11 only publishes broad theft at station level, so vehicle crime and shop theft cannot be separated without a different official source.

categories.label: All published station categories
categories.description: Sum of the categories published in CJA11 for this station and year. Fraud is unavailable from 2024, so recent totals exclude it.

categories.label: Home safety
categories.description: Burglary and related offences. CJA11 does not separate residential from non-residential burglary at station level.

categories.label: Property crime
categories.description: Burglary plus damage to property and the environment.

categories.label: Disorder
categories.description: Weapons, criminal damage and public-order offences.

categories.label: Recorded drug activity
categories.description: Strongly affected by policing and enforcement activity.

categories.label: Theft / retail
categories.description: All theft and related offences. CJA11 does not separate shop theft or vehicle theft at station level.

categories.label: Fraud, deception & related offences
categories.availabilityNote: 2023 is not comparable; station-level values are unavailable from 2024 due to the financial-institution reporting backlog.
